PSALM XCII. 
 
  God is praised for his works, ver. 1-5.   The doom of the wicked, from the eternal God, ver. 6-9.   The prosperity of the righteous, ver. 10-15.   A psalm or song for the sabbath-day.
V. 5. Thoughts-Thy counsels in the government of the world and of thy church.
V. 6. A brutish man-Who is led by sense, not by reason and faith. This-The depth of God's counsels and works.
V. 10. Anointed-I shall have cause of testifying my joy by anointing myself, as the manner was at all joyful solemnities.
V. 12. Palm-tree-Which is constantly green and flourishing.
V. 13. Planted-Whom God by his gracious providence has fixed there. The house-In its courts; he means in the church of God, whereof all good men are living members.
V. 14. Old age-Their last days shall be their best days, wherein they shall grow in grace, and increase in blessedness.
